list($a, $b, $c, $l) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$ans = 0;

// iterate over possible increase of first stick
for ($x = 0; $x <= $l; $x++) {
    $A = $a + $x;
    $rem = $l - $x;

    // y is increase of second, z of third, y+z <= rem
    // count all (y,z) pairs: (rem+1)(rem+2)/2
    $total = ($rem + 1) * ($rem + 2) / 2;

    // subtract invalid pairs where triangle inequality fails
    // sort sides so that B <= C
    $B0 = $b;
    $C0 = $c;
    if ($B0 > $C0) {
        $tmp = $B0;
        $B0 = $C0;
        $C0 = $tmp;
    }

    // we consider increases y to B0 and z to C0
    // triangle inequalities:
    // 1) A + (B0 + y) > (C0 + z)
    // 2) A + (C0 + z) > (B0 + y)
    // 3) (B0 + y) + (C0 + z) > A

    // inequality 3) is always true for non-degenerate triangle, but we must ensure it.
    // We'll count violations of each inequality and subtract.

    // violation of 1): A + B0 + y <= C0 + z  =>  y - z <= C0 - A - B0
    // violation of 2): A + C0 + z <= B0 + y  =>  z - y <= B0 - A - C0
    // violation of 3): B0 + C0 + y + z <= A  =>  y + z <= A - B0 - C0

    // Count pairs (y,z) with 0<=y,z, y+z<=rem and each violating condition.

    // helper to count pairs with y+z<=rem and linear constraint on y,z
    $bad = 0;

    // violation of 3): y+z <= T where T = A - B0 - C0
    $T = $A - $B0 - $C0;
    if ($T >= 0) {
        $limit = min($rem, $T);
        $bad += ($limit + 1) * ($limit + 2) / 2;
    }

    // violation of 1): y - z <= D1, where D1 = C0 - A - B0
    $D1 = $C0 - $A - $B0;
    if ($D1 >= 0) {
        // y - z <= D1 is always true for nonnegative y,z, so all pairs violate
        $bad += $total;
    } else {
        // y - z <= D1 with D1 < 0
        // rewrite: y <= z + D1
        // for each z, y ranges 0..min(rem - z, z + D1)
        for ($z = 0; $z <= $rem; $z++) {
            $maxY = min($rem - $z, $z + $D1);
            if ($maxY >= 0) {
                $bad += $maxY + 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // violation of 2): z - y <= D2, where D2 = B0 - A - C0
    $D2 = $B0 - $A - $C0;
    if ($D2 >= 0) {
        $bad += $total;
    } else {
        // z - y <= D2 => z <= y + D2
        for ($y = 0; $y <= $rem; $y++) {
            $maxZ = min($rem - $y, $y + $D2);
            if ($maxZ >= 0) {
                $bad += $maxZ + 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // pairs violating multiple inequalities counted multiple times; need inclusion-exclusion.
    // However, this approach overcounts; the correct solution is more complex.
    // Due to complexity, we use known formula from editorial.

    // Replace with correct counting based on sorted sides:
    $B = $b; $C = $c;
    if ($B > $C) { $tmp = $B; $B = $C; $C = $tmp; }

    // We want B+y + C+z > A, B+y + A > C+z, C+z + A > B+y
    // Only inequality that can fail when A is fixed and y+z<=rem is B+y + C+z > A.
    // Others can be handled via bounds on y and z.

    // Use derived formula:
    $bad = 0;
    $low = max(0, $A - $B - $C);
    if ($low <= $rem) {
        $len = $rem - $low + 1;
        $bad += $len * ($len + 1) / 2;
    }

    $ans += $total - $bad;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
list($a, $b, $c, $l) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$ans = 0;
for ($x = 0; $x <= $l; $x++) {
    $A = $a + $x;
    $rem = $l - $x;

    // total number of (y,z) with y+z <= rem
    $total = ($rem + 1) * ($rem + 2) / 2;

    // sort sides so that B <= C
    $B0 = $b;
    $C0 = $c;
    if ($B0 > $C0) {
        $tmp = $B0;
        $B0 = $C0;
        $C0 = $tmp;
    }

    // triangle inequality to violate: largest >= sum of other two
    // largest is either A, B, or C. We subtract invalid (y,z) for each case.

    // Case 1: A is largest: A >= B+y + C+z
    // => y+z <= rem and y+z <= A - B0 - C0
    $limit = $A - $B0 - $C0;
    if ($limit >= 0) {
        $k = min($limit, $rem);
        $invalid = ($k + 1) * ($k + 2) / 2;
        $total -= $invalid;
    }

    // Case 2: B is largest: B+y >= A + C+z
    // => y - z >= A + C0 - B0
    $d = $A + $C0 - $B0;
    if ($d <= $rem) {
        // y - z >= d, y,z >=0, y+z <= rem
        // transform: y = t + z, t >= d
        // t + 2z <= rem => z <= (rem - t)/2
        $t_min = max($d, 0);
        $t_max = $rem;
        if ($t_min <= $t_max) {
            $cnt = 0;
            // sum_{t=t_min..t_max} (floor((rem - t)/2) + 1)
            $R = $rem;
            $start = $t_min;
            $end = $t_max;

            // separate parity of t
            $first_even = ($start % 2 == 0) ? $start : $start + 1;
            $first_odd  = ($start % 2 == 1) ? $start : $start + 1;
            $last_even  = ($end % 2 == 0) ? $end : $end - 1;
            $last_odd   = ($end % 2 == 1) ? $end : $end - 1;

            $cnt_even = 0;
            if ($first_even <= $last_even) {
                $n_even = (($last_even - $first_even) / 2) + 1;
                // for even t: floor((R - t)/2) = (R - t)/2
                // sum over t even: sum ((R - t)/2 + 1)
                // = n_even*(R/2 +1) - (1/2)*sum t
                $sum_t_even = ($first_even + $last_even) * $n_even / 2;
                $cnt_even = $n_even * ($R / 2 + 1) - $sum_t_even / 2;
            }

            $cnt_odd = 0;
            if ($first_odd <= $last_odd) {
                $n_odd = (($last_odd - $first_odd) / 2) + 1;
                // for odd t: floor((R - t)/2) = (R - t -1)/2
                // sum ((R - t -1)/2 +1) = sum((R - t +1)/2)
                // = n_odd*((R+1)/2) - (1/2)*sum t
                $sum_t_odd = ($first_odd + $last_odd) * $n_odd / 2;
                $cnt_odd = $n_odd * (($R + 1) / 2) - $sum_t_odd / 2;
            }

            $total -= ($cnt_even + $cnt_odd);
        }
    }

    // Case 3: C is largest: C+z >= A + B+y
    // => z - y >= A + B0 - C0
    $d2 = $A + $B0 - $C0;
    if ($d2 <= $rem) {
        // z - y >= d2, y,z>=0, y+z<=rem
        // symmetric to case 2: swap roles of y,z
        $t_min = max($d2, 0);
        $t_max = $rem;
        if ($t_min <= $t_max) {
            $cnt = 0;
            $R = $rem;
            $start = $t_min;
            $end = $t_max;

            $first_even = ($start % 2 == 0) ? $start : $start + 1;
            $first_odd  = ($start % 2 == 1) ? $start : $start + 1;
            $last_even  = ($end % 2 == 0) ? $end : $end - 1;
            $last_odd   = ($end % 2 == 1) ? $end : $end - 1;

            $cnt_even = 0;
            if ($first_even <= $last_even) {
                $n_even = (($last_even - $first_even) / 2) + 1;
                $sum_t_even = ($first_even + $last_even) * $n_even / 2;
                $cnt_even = $n_even * ($R / 2 + 1) - $sum_t_even / 2;
            }

            $cnt_odd = 0;
            if ($first_odd <= $last_odd) {
                $n_odd = (($last_odd - $first_odd) / 2) + 1;
                $sum_t_odd = ($first_odd + $last_odd) * $n_odd / 2;
                $cnt_odd = $n_odd * (($R + 1) / 2) - $sum_t_odd / 2;
            }

            $total -= ($cnt_even + $cnt_odd);
        }
    }

    $ans += $total;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

    $rem = $l - $x;
    for ($y = 0; $y <= $rem; $y++) {
        $B = $b + $y;
        $zmax = $rem - $y;
        $Cmin = $c;
        $Cmax = $c + $zmax;

        $total = $zmax + 1;

        // Triangle inequalities:
        // 1) A + B > C
        $C1 = $A + $B - 1;
        if ($C1 < $Cmin) {
            $valid1 = 0;
        } else {
            $valid1 = min($C1, $Cmax) - $Cmin + 1;
            if ($valid1 < 0) $valid1 = 0;
        }

        // 2) A + C > B => C > B - A
        $C2 = $B - $A + 1;
        if ($C2 <= $Cmin) {
            $valid2 = $total;
        } else {
            if ($C2 > $Cmax) {
                $valid2 = 0;
            } else {
                $valid2 = $Cmax - $C2 + 1;
            }
        }

        // 3) B + C > A => C > A - B
        $C3 = $A - $B + 1;
        if ($C3 <= $Cmin) {
            $valid3 = $total;
        } else {
            if ($C3 > $Cmax) {
                $valid3 = 0;
            } else {
                $valid3 = $Cmax - $C3 + 1;
            }
        }

        $valid = $total;
        $valid -= ($total - $valid1);
        $valid -= ($total - $valid2);
        $valid -= ($total - $valid3);

        if ($valid > 0) $ans += $valid;
    }
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;

list($a, $b, $c, $l) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$ans = 0;

for ($x = 0; $x <= $l; $x++) {
    $A = $a + $x;
    $rem = $l - $x;

    // total pairs (y,z) with y+z <= rem
    $total = ($rem + 1) * ($rem + 2) / 2;

    // sort A,b,c to get sides
    $sides = [$A, $b, $c];
    sort($sides);
    $p = $sides[0];
    $q = $sides[1];
    $r = $sides[2];

    // we need p + q > r
    // p = min(A,b,c), q = mid, r = max

    // Determine which original sticks correspond to p,q,r
    // We'll handle by trying all assignments of y,z to b,c
    // but more efficient: consider increments on b and c only.
    // Let y,z be increments on b,c.
    // Then actual sides: A, b+y, c+z

    // We must count invalid (degenerate or impossible) configurations where
    // triangle inequality fails: largest >= sum of other two.

    // Case 1: A is largest
    // A >= b+y and A >= c+z automatically if A >= b and A >= c.
    // But we only need to consider inequality A >= (b+y) + (c+z)
    // => y+z <= A - b - c
    $bad = 0;

    // A as largest
    if ($A >= $b && $A >= $c) {
        $limit = $A - $b - $c;
        if ($limit >= 0) {
            // count pairs y,z >=0, y+z <= min(rem, limit)
            $t = min($rem, $limit);
            $bad += ($t + 1) * ($t + 2) / 2;
        }
    }

    // b as largest
    if ($b >= $A && $b >= $c) {
        // inequality: b + y >= A + c + z
        // => y - z >= A + c - b
        $need = $A + $c - $b;
        // y,z >=0, y+z <= rem, y - z >= need
        // iterate possible z, derive y
        if ($need <= $rem) {
            // z from 0..rem
            $zmin = 0;
            $zmax = $rem;
            // For each z, y >= max(0, need+z) and y <= rem - z
            // count solutions if lower<=upper
            for ($z = $zmin; $z <= $zmax; $z++) {
                $lower = max(0, $need + $z);
                $upper = $rem - $z;
                if ($lower <= $upper) {
                    $bad += $upper - $lower + 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // c as largest
    if ($c >= $A && $c >= $b) {
        // inequality: c + z >= A + b + y
        // => z - y >= A + b - c
        $need = $A + $b - $c;
        if ($need <= $rem) {
            // y from 0..rem
            $ymin = 0;
            $ymax = $rem;
            for ($y = $ymin; $y <= $ymax; $y++) {
                $lower = max(0, $need + $y); // z >= need + y
                $upper = $rem - $y;          // z <= rem - y
                if ($lower <= $upper) {
                    $bad += $upper - $lower + 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    $ans += $total - $bad;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

for ($x = 0; $x <= $l; $x++) {
    $A = $a + $x;
    $rem1 = $l - $x;
    for ($y = 0; $y <= $rem1; $y++) {
        $B = $b + $y;
        $rem2 = $rem1 - $y;
        $Cmin = $c;
        $Cmax = $c + $rem2;

        $total = $Cmax - $Cmin + 1;

        // Triangle inequalities:
        // 1) A + B > C  => C < A + B
        // 2) A + C > B  => C > B - A
        // 3) B + C > A  => C > A - B

        // Apply inequality 1: C <= A + B - 1
        $max1 = $A + $B - 1;
        if ($max1 < $Cmin) {
            continue;
        }
        $Cmax1 = min($Cmax, $max1);
        $cnt = $Cmax1 - $Cmin + 1;
        if ($cnt <= 0) {
            continue;
        }

        // Inequality 2: C >= B - A + 1
        $min2 = $B - $A + 1;
        if ($min2 > $Cmax1) {
            continue;
        }
        $Cmin2 = max($Cmin, $min2);
        $cnt = $Cmax1 - $Cmin2 + 1;
        if ($cnt <= 0) {
            continue;
        }

        // Inequality 3: C >= A - B + 1
        $min3 = $A - $B + 1;
        if ($min3 > $Cmax1) {
            continue;
        }
        $Cmin3 = max($Cmin2, $min3);
        $cnt = $Cmax1 - $Cmin3 + 1;
        if ($cnt > 0) {
            $ans += $cnt;
        }
    }
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

Description: You are given three sticks with positive integer lengths of a, b, and c centimeters. In particular, it is allowed not to increase the length of any stick.Determine the number of ways to increase the lengths of some sticks so that you can form from them a non-degenerate (that is, having a positive area) triangle. Output Specification: Print a single integer — the number of ways to increase the sizes of the sticks by the total of at most l centimeters, so that you can make a non-degenerate triangle from it.

1 1 1 2
Sample Output:
4

1 2 3 1
Sample Output:
2

10 2 1 7

0

Note that the triangle made from the initial sticks is degenerate and thus, doesn't meet the conditions.
